title: Compile minimal new experiments from retained operator uncertainty
statement: Factor A=N^T W T^T into k rank-one terms. Query inputs realizing its k input factors, read free output residual coordinates and contract. A deterministic algorithm using fewer than k directions has an indistinguishable rational completion changing the requested functional.

requires: Fixed linear source, exact rational full-vector forward actions in known coordinates, certified relation rows and consistent complete retained observation history, and a newly supplied linear functional W. No native transpose is assumed.
provides: Factor A=N^T W T^T into k rank-one terms. Query inputs realizing its k input factors, read free output residual coordinates and contract. A deterministic algorithm using fewer than k directions has an indistinguishable rational completion changing the requested functional.
assumptions: The lower bound is not for scalar observations, randomized bounded-error methods, noisy acquisition, coefficient-bit-size promises, supplied source formulas, transpose access or additional structural restrictions. An equally informed retaining algorithm uses the same laws/data and ties the query bound. Learned relations do not identify a unique microscopic mechanism. This does not supersede N996's different vector/transpose defect-calculus theorem.
costs: Each query returns m scalars. Local relation discovery can cost a combinatorial support search. The reported two tasks use two queries each and leave 16 response parameters unresolved; input/output rationals reach 170/200 bits. Initialization costs 4,645 Fraction operations; generic task plans 14,913/18,147; a zero-query specialization reduces 16,129 to 76 operations. These are source-reported software controls, not total-runtime or architecture-superiority evidence.
contract.units: Query counts are dimensionless; H maps declared input coordinates/units to output coordinates/units and W supplies the functional units. Exact rational precision and returned widths are charged.
contract.obstruction: Noise, observation calibration, finite precision, physical instruments, practical advantage and historical priority remain unresolved. Additional structure or source changes need new certification. Finding relations and accepting a false relation have distinct probability budgets.

body: Construct H0 by elimination using independent old inputs and compatible responses. Differences satisfy C Delta=0 and Delta U=0, hence uniquely Delta=NZT. This gives the missing coefficient A. A rank factorization yields k full-vector experiments; evaluate all against the original H0 before updating retained observations. For a lower bound follow a deterministic algorithm on H0: if fewer than rank(A) transformed input directions were queried, choose rational v perpendicular to them with Av nonzero and Z=(Av)v^T. All queried full vectors remain identical while the functional changes by ||Av||^2. The completion class and exact deterministic contract are essential.
